Sound familiar?

You've done everything you were told to do.

You've bought the course and still have no sale.
You post every day and nobody buys.
You don't know what to sell, or who to sell it to.
Your content reads like every other AI post, and people scroll past.
You're afraid of DMs and sales calls, so you hide.

That isn't a talent problem. It's a clarity problem. Fix the offer, the words, and the conversation, and sales follow.

The fix

Small offers. Sharp words. Real conversations.

Pick a small offer

A simple, low-priced product that solves one problem, so your first buyer says yes fast.

Write like a human

Direct-response copy that sounds like you at the kitchen table, not like a robot reading a script.

Sell without calls

Organic Facebook posts and friendly DMs. That's how I sell, and it's how I teach it.

About

I'm Rob. Here's what you're dealing with.

I'm a solo marketer. I build small offers, write the copy, and sell through organic Facebook posts and messages. No sales calls. No ring light.

I love Jesus, and I'm not ashamed of the Bible. I know. In marketing. Scandalous. I'm a husband, a dad of a big family and a minister, and I'll tell you what I think whether you asked or not.

I also like attention. I will do something absurd in public for fun and see who stops to look. That's the job, honestly. Marketing is getting people to turn their heads, then having something worth saying when they do.

So here's the deal. I run experiments in the open and hand you what works. If you want a guru, there's a line forming down the street. If you want a first sale, start with a free tool.
